# AgentOrange-public

Build output for the [AgentOrange](https://github.com/Mikkel-Gram/AgentOrange) PWA.

**Do not edit this repository by hand.** Every file here is overwritten by the
`DeployProduction` workflow in the private AgentOrange repository.

It exists only because GitHub Pages requires a public repository on the free
plan, while the source repository is private.

Published at https://mikkel-gram.github.io/AgentOrange-public/
